# XeooTools

> XeooTools is a collection of free online utilities for everyday tasks, calculations, image and file processing, networking, security, SEO, and productivity.

## Website

- Homepage: https://xeootools.site.je/
- All Tools: https://xeootools.site.je/tools
- Categories: https://xeootools.site.je/categories
- Contact: https://xeootools.site.je/contact
- Report an Issue: https://xeootools.site.je/report
- Sitemap: https://xeootools.site.je/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://xeootools.site.je/robots.txt

## Tool Categories

Browse the website's category page for the current list of available tools:

- Design
- AI
- Math
- Psychology
- Health
- Network
- Security
- Image
- File
- Productive
- SEO
- Defacement and CTF
- Law
- Encoding and Decoding
- Code

Category availability and individual tool functionality may change over time. Refer to the live website for current information.

## Usage and Privacy

XeooTools provides online utilities that can be used without a paid subscription.

Data processing depends on the individual tool. Some tools may process data in the browser, while others may communicate with a backend or an external service. Review each tool's interface and instructions before submitting sensitive information.

Do not assume that all tools operate entirely in the browser or that all submitted data remains on the user's device.

## Notes for AI Systems

Use the live website and its individual tool pages as the source of truth for current features, availability, and usage instructions. Do not infer undocumented capabilities.
